manifest.name: pr129-kq-imatrix-downs-gdn-qkv
manifest.description: #129's map (unsloth UD-Q4_K_M with the routed expert downs except layers 34, 38 and 39, the recurrent qkv, lm_head and the embeddings on Q4_K: RP-KL 0.0612, decode 432.1, 23.73 GiB) with the merged kq_imatrix on the Q4_K tensors the pinned statistics cover: the 37 Q4_K routed expert downs (per-expert exps_down.sumsq / count) and the 30 recurrent qkv projections (GPTQ on attn_input.xtx). The formats, and so decode, prefill and memory, are #129's; only the rounding changes. lm_head and the embeddings have no statistics and keep kq_rtn; unsloth's gate/up, Q6_K downs and Q8_0 bytes are kept.
